insurer_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Co. Ltd.
residency_requirement: Indian resident; treatment in India only
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Senior citizen plan; PED waiting at 24 months from inception

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Minimum 2 hours admission required (lower than usual 24-hour rule) for hospitalization claims; modern treatments covered with sub-limits

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All listed day care procedures covered up to sum insured

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Treating doctor must certify hospital admission was not possible; minimum 3 consecutive days

ayush_coverage.notes: Minimum 24-hour admission in an AYUSH Hospital required

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Hospitalisation expenses of donor for organ harvesting, only when the insured's hospitalization claim is paid

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance up to Rs. 2,000 per hospitalization; air ambulance up to Rs. 2,50,000 per hospitalization (emergency only)

restoration_benefit.limit_text: ReAssure benefit — unlimited sum insured triggered after first paid claim; maximum amount per single claim capped at base sum insured
restoration_benefit.notes: Available after first paid claim during the policy year

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Available once every policy year from day 1, up to amount specified in policy schedule
preventive_health_checkup.notes: Tests must be completed within 7 days

room_rent_capping: Eligible room category as per policy schedule; additional 10% co-payment applies if higher room category chosen
copayment_trigger_notes: Voluntary co-payment chosen at inception (fixed for the policy); additional 10% co-payment if treatment taken in higher than eligible room category

disease_wise_sub_limits.robotic_surgery: Rs. 1,00,000 per claim (except radical prostatectomy, cardiac surgeries, partial nephrectomy, and surgeries for malignancies)

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Policy covers treatment taken in India only

notable_exclusions_summary: Senior-citizen indemnity plan with shortened 24-month PED and specific waiting. Excludes standard IRDAI list (cosmetic surgery, refractive error, infertility, adventure sports, breach of law). Out-of-India treatment not covered.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Niva Bupa network hospitals on pre-authorization; reimbursement claims submitted to insurer with hospital documents post-discharge.
